next_step: Deliver KMS integration runbook + schedule security deep-dive
notes:
Summary: Enterprise finance platform evaluating Redwood Private VPC with customer-managed keys (BYOK) and HSM-backed KMS. Primary ask: vendor cannot hold root keys; must integrate with AWS KMS CMK (BYOK import) and support Azure Key Vault + GCP KMS for multi-cloud.

CTO quote: "We will not accept vendor-managed master keys — zero exception."

Key technical requirements:
- BYOK flow for AWS KMS (CMK import) and Azure Key Vault HSM-backed keys (Managed HSM).
- Support for CloudHSM / Azure Dedicated HSM / External HSM (Thales) for key generation/import.
- Envelope encryption: model weights and checkpoints encrypted at rest; data-at-rest encryption must use customer CMKs.
- Key rotation policy support and automated key rotation grace windows.
- KMS grants / cross-account IAM roles for Redwood control plane to use keys without key transfer.
- Audit logging: CloudTrail / Cloud Audit Logs integration, push to customer SIEM (Splunk), 7-year retention for certain audit events.
- Transit security: TLS 1.2+ and mutual TLS for control-plane communications; private endpoints (VPC endpoints) required.

POC scope / success criteria:
- Deploy Redwood Private in Saffron VPC (us-east-1) with VPC peering and interface endpoints.
- Configure AWS KMS BYOK imported CMK + envelope encryption; validate key usage metrics in CloudTrail.
- Demonstrate model serving at p50 latency < 200ms for chat workload and throughput 2k req/s (batching enabled).
- Show audit logs forwarded to customer SIEM and sample retention policy implemented.
- Validate key rotation without downtime (failover to rotated key).

Engagement timeline / activities:
- 2026-02-14: Intro + requirements call (FF ff-2026-02-14-AX9Q).
- 2026-02-28: Security questionnaire submitted (see drive doc).
- 2026-03-02: Legal flagged BYOK contract clause (needs redline).
- 2026-03-09: Architecture deep-dive with infra team (workshop).
- 2026-03-10: Follow-up notes and action items.
- Target POC start: 2026-04-01.

Open questions / blockers:
- Legal: acceptable BYOK key custody language, liability for imported keys.
- Network: approval for VPC peering and Egress NAT gateway pattern.
- Tech: need sample key-policy and minimal IAM role that allows Redwood runtime to use CMK via grants.
- Compliance: need SOC2 artefacts from Redwood + encryption attestation (FIPS/HSM).

Next steps (short):
- Send KMS integration runbook + architecture diagram (EOD).
- Share sample key policy and IAM trust document.
- Schedule security deep-dive w/ Saffron infra + legal (owner: Maya).
- Prep SOW draft for enterprise Private deployment including HSM add-on pricing.

Stubs/links: security FAQ (drive), pricing SOW (drive:/Redwood/pricing/saffron-private-sow-v1.pdf), Jira RDW-4521 tracking key-import validation.

Sales notes / tone: High enterprise value, low tolerance for key custody risk; procurement timeline tied to legal BYOK approvals. Keep SE heavily involved (Ethan on calls).
